decision.justification: Selected 'weighted weighted by w6' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.955. Series context: trend strength 0.9774 and seasonal strength 0.4288; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.173); 2 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.514.
